title: zanthoxylum emarginatum
intro: Zanthoxylum emarginatum, commonly known as the Sharp Pepper Tree or Mexican Prickly Ash, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. It is a small tree or shrub native to Mexico, valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The Sharp Pepper Tree has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral effects. The bioactive constituents of Zanthoxylum emarginatum, including limonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, contribute to its medicinal properties and provide relief from various health conditions.
